newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel prices fall with futures losses.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel prices fall with futures losses.

text.p: NWE jet fuel oil prices weakened on Wednesday in line with sharp drops in benchmark IPE gas oil futures, traders said.
July IPE gas oil futures closed $5.0 lower at $158.75 a tonne.
Premiums were little changed at around July IPE +$14.50/+$15.50 fob ARA as plentiful stocks amid weak demand continued to pressure the market.

"There's just no demand out there. People appear to have good stocks and they're not going to come in to buy when futures appear to be heading down," one trader said. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
